by an imbalanced diet. The correct answers were: “anger and irritation” and “find it hard to get on with other
children”. Most candidates managed to provide two correct points. A few candidates made ‘anger’ and
‘irritation’ two separate points and only achieved 1 mark rather than 2.

details.
